notes: Single-harness setup (universal root only, unlike trace 01's same skill with a claude-code link); removing it drops the .skill-lock.json entry entirely. Uses academy-guide (not canvas-design) to keep the fixture small - canvas-design ships ~5MB of font assets. Every file body under a skills/<name>/ folder fetched from a remote source (including LICENSE.txt, when present) is stored on disk as a one-line stub (`stub sha256=<original hash> bytes=<n>`), never the real third-party content; tree.json still records the ORIGINAL sha256/length, and cli_parity.rs compares against that original hash, not the stub's own bytes.
